tagline: Your day, exactly as you imagined it.
audience: engaged couples who want a boutique wedding planner to handle the details of a small, personal wedding with calm and good taste
voice: warm, calm and quietly witty. Short sentences, specific details, a little romance, never saccharine and never salesy.
designNotes: Playful-pastel design language recoloured to warm cream with dusty blue and champagne borders, Cormorant Garamond headings and Lora body, pill buttons with dotted outlines.
brandFacts: Evermore Weddings, 12 Church Street, Charleston, SC 29401. Phone (843) 555-0164. hello@evermoreweddings.com. Sample copy: names, prices and reviews are examples to replace.
description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for a wedding planner, florist, event stylist, venue or photographer, ready to make your own. Home, Real Weddings, Planning, Venues, About and Contact share one soft, romantic identity: warm cream, dusty blue, champagne borders, Cormorant Garamond headings and pill buttons with dotted outlines. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. An overlapping photo hero, a ratings strip, a scrolling services row, a three-step gallery, a full-bleed couple quote, a real-weddings grid, a detail gallery, a quote slider, three planning packages, a before-and-after of a transformed barn, venue stories, indoor-versus-outdoor panels, a planner team and a founder note are all in place. Names, prices and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
